# Synthetic native-preview fixture

`table.hwpx` is a generated 2×2 table with colored borders. Its only text is
`색 테두리 교차 J01` and the four row/column labels. It contains no external or
user document content. It exercises authored cell geometry and source-cache
exclusion with a synthetic glyph provider, independently of any font library.
